name: W48 MPLS Planet Fitness — Return to Load (Mon–Fri)

monday.label: Push (Chest / Shoulders / Triceps)
monday.warmup: Treadmill incline walk 5 min easy + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2 + DB front raise 5 lbs × 10 + ramp-up sets of incline press at 30 ea × 8, 45 ea × 4, 55 ea × 1
monday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + doorway pec stretch 60s ea side + cross-body shoulder stretch 60s ea side + overhead triceps stretch 60s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water

exercises.notes: Back to the pre-layoff load: 50 ea went 12/12/12. Set 1 under 8 → 55 ea for sets 2–3. Deep stretch at the bottom, wrists stacked. If holding the 60s bothers the forearm, use 55s
50 ea went 12/12/10 → one step. Pre-layoff was 60. Rack the DBs before anything grinds
25 went 10/10/10 → 30, the pre-layoff load. Slow into the stretch
40 ea went 12/12/10 → one step. Pre-layoff was 50 in this slot. Strict, no leg drive
15s irritated the forearm on 11/18 and 10s were fine, so 10 ea for all three sets. Loose grip, no swing. Any irritation at 10 → stop and note it
35 went 12/15/15 → 40, the pre-layoff load. Elbows pinned, easy grip on the rope
50 went 10/12/12 → one step. Pre-layoff was 60. Seated with back support; get the DB into position with both hands

tuesday.label: Pull (Back / Biceps / Rear Delts)
tuesday.warmup: Rower 5 min easy + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2 + ramp-up sets of lat pulldown at 70 × 8 then 100 × 4
tuesday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + child's pose with side reach 60s ea side + cross-body rear-delt stretch 60s ea side. No forearm stretching. 16 oz electrolyte water

exercises.notes: 10/9/8 on 11/19 → same load, same target. Chest up, full stretch at the top, no lean-back
115 went 10/10/10 → one step. Pre-layoff was 135, with 140 banked. Pause at the chest
8/8/8 on 11/19 → same load, same target. LEFT first, right matches left's reps, no torso heave. Forearm lift: stop at the first symptom
50 went 12/12/12 → one step. Pre-layoff was 60, with 65 banked. Rope to the ears, strict
15 ea went 12/12/12 → 20, the pre-layoff load. 12 × 3 here puts the banked 25 ea in W49. Soft elbows
Forearm lift: 40 triggered the injury on 11/19 and 20 was fine, so the same 20 × 10 × 2. No hip swing
Forearm lift: the 10 ea you used on 11/19. Skip it at the first hint of discomfort and log why
Forearm lift: same as 11/19. 20 s each side, LEFT hand first. Set it down early if the grip fades

wednesday.label: Legs (Quads / Hams / Glutes / Calves / Core)
wednesday.warmup: Easy treadmill 5–8 min + controlled bodyweight squats × 10 + glute bridges × 10 + ramp-up sets: squat bar × 8, 95 × 5, 120 × 3; leg press 200 × 8
wednesday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + standing quad stretch 45s ea side + hamstring stretch 45s ea side + calf stretch 45s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water. Thermocycling tonight if the session was flag-free

exercises.notes: Back to the pre-layoff load: 120 went 10/10/10 against a cap of 8. 45 + 2.5 per side. Safety pins set. Set 1 under 8 → 130 for sets 2–3
290 went 10/10/10 → one step. Pre-layoff was 320. 45+45+45+10+5 per side. Do not bottom out
Your 120 went 10/10/10 with no grip complaint. It holds this week because the forearm isn't quiet; 140 comes after a quiet week. Double-overhand, no straps, slow on the way down
75 went 12/12/12 → 80, reps reset to 10. Full range, pause at the bottom
100/95/95 × 10 → 100 on all three sets. Pre-layoff was 110. Chin tucked; sit up 20–30 s before standing
230/220/220 × 12 → 230 on all three sets. Pre-layoff was 260. Full range, 1 s pause, no bounce
50 went 12/12/12 → one step. Pre-layoff was 60. Exhale into the crunch, easy grip
12/12/12 at the 25 plate → reps back to the 15 that locked on 10/21. 15 × 3 → 35. Smooth, no hyperextension

thursday.label: Upper Hybrid (Shoulders / Chest / Back / Arms / Core)
thursday.warmup: Rower 5 min easy + scap circles + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2 + ramp-up sets of shoulder press at 20 ea × 8 then 35 ea × 4
thursday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + doorway pec stretch 60s ea side + child's pose with side reach 60s ea side + cross-body shoulder stretch 60s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water

exercises.notes: First time in this slot since 10/22, when it was 55 ea. Same load as Monday. Strict, no leg drive
The load that went 12/12/12 on 11/18. Lighter second exposure, 10 under Monday
Same as Monday; the 15s irritated the forearm. Loose grip, no swing
Same load as Tuesday. Rope to the ears
Forearm lift, W47 load (not done last week). LEFT first, right matches left's reps
Forearm lift: 10 ea matches the 20-lb barbell curl that was fine. No swing
First time since 10/22 (35, 8/8/6). Cap 8. Elbows still, no bounce at the bottom
First time since 10/22 (55, 12/10/10). LEFT side first; exhale on the press-out, no twist
45 s each side, LEFT first. The left side rests on the forearm: stop that side if it is uncomfortable and log the time

friday.label: Lower Hybrid (Glutes / Quads / Hams / Calves / Core)
friday.warmup: Easy bike or treadmill 5–8 min + controlled bodyweight squats × 10 + glute bridges × 10 + ramp-up sets on the single-leg press (90 lbs × 6 each leg, left first)
friday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + quad, hamstring and calf stretches 45s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water. Thermocycling tonight if the session was flag-free

exercises.notes: Was 180 (6/10/10 on 10/23). 45+25+5 per side. LEFT first, right matches left's reps, pain-free depth
Was 25 ea (15 × 3 on 10/23). Cap 10 per leg for soreness. LEFT leg steps first
12/15/15 on 11/10. Set 1 needs 15 to finish the lock; 15 × 3 → 50
Same load and target as Wednesday
100 went 15 × 3 three sessions running → 105, reps reset to 12. Torso still, brief pause open; 15 × 3 → 110
12 × 3 at 80 three sessions running; reps climb to 15 at the same load. Controlled return; 15 × 3 → 85
Was 50 ea (13/13/12 on 10/23). LEFT first, right matches; full range, 1 s pause
Same load as Wednesday. Exhale into the crunch
